spanish: No harán calva en su cabeza, y extremo de su barba no rasurarán, y en su carne no cortarán corte.

findings.issue: Unmarked supplied verb harán adds an act of making. Those tokens are only negative + feminine singular noun + preposition and their head; no verb is licensed.

notes: The shave and cut clauses keep the negatives, 3mp verbs, singular objects, and 3mp suffixes.
